The '''Novor system''' was a 16-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] located on the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]. The only inhabitable planet was [[Novor 23]]. The system originally had 33 planets, but the 17 innermost planets were destroyed when the system's primary, [[Novor Major]], expanded into its [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] phase. The remaining planets were largely unaffected, and the remains of the destroyed worlds created the [[Novor Asteroid Field]].<ref name="SotSR" />
